definitions.gloss: fallow rice field; idle paddy; uncultivated rice paddy
definitions.explanation: A rice paddy that has been temporarily or permanently taken out of cultivation. A significant issue in rural Japan as the agricultural population declines.

examples.japanese: ⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Fallow rice fields are increasing in the village.

examples.japanese: {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}して→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧⟦{太陽光|たいようこう}→太陽光：06209_taiyoukou⟧⟦パネル→パネル：08840_paneru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Solar panels were installed to make use of fallow fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}り→減る：01985_heru⟧、{休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{再利用|さいりよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{始|はじ}まっている→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: As farmers decrease due to aging, the area of fallow fields expands year by year, but efforts to reuse them are also beginning.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{休耕|きゅうこう}→休耕：19194_kyuukou⟧ (fallow, lying idle) + {田|でん} (rice paddy). A term frequently seen in discussions of Japan's agricultural policy, rural depopulation, and land use. The Japanese government has historically paid subsidies for {減反|げんたん} (rice acreage reduction), leading many farmers to leave paddies fallow.

Some {休耕田|きゅうこうでん} are repurposed for solar power generation, flower fields for tourism, or converted to other crops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: fallow fields increase
- {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to utilize fallow fields
- {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再利用|さいりよう}→再利用：18649_sairiyou⟧: reuse of fallow fields
- {休耕田|きゅうこうでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: management of fallow fields

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {耕作放棄地|こうさくほうきち}: abandoned farmland — land that has been left uncultivated for a longer period with no plan to resume
- {休耕地|きゅうこうち}: fallow land — a more general term not limited to rice paddies
- ⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧: rice paddy — the general colloquial word for a rice field, whether active or not
